items.title: Potato chips
items.body: Thin fried slices of potato with salt. The default crunch.

items.title: Apple slices
items.body: A whole fruit cut into something you can share.

items.title: Dark chocolate
items.body: A square or two after dinner, bitter enough to feel grown up.

items.title: Charcuterie board
items.body: Cured meats, cheeses and pickles arranged like a still life.

items.title: Trail mix
items.body: Nuts, seeds and raisins, with the chocolate picked out first.

items.title: Popcorn
items.body: Kernels turned inside out by heat. Better with a movie.

items.title: Macarons
items.body: Almond meringue shells with a filling, in colors that match nothing in nature.

items.title: Hummus and pita
items.body: Chickpeas blended smooth, scooped with warm bread.

items.title: Gummy bears
items.body: Chewy fruit-flavored bears, eaten by the handful.

items.title: Midnight cereal
items.body: Whatever is in the cupboard, eaten standing up. A snack as a mood more than a food.

items.title: Superhero sequel
items.body: Costumes, a city in peril and a post-credits scene promising more.

items.title: Silent slapstick
items.body: Pratfalls and chases told entirely through timing.

items.title: Arthouse dream film
items.body: Long takes, few words, a plot you assemble on the walk home.

items.title: Heist thriller
items.body: A crew, a vault and a plan that goes wrong in the right ways.

items.title: Nature documentary
items.body: Patient footage of animals doing remarkable things, with calm narration.

items.title: Tearjerker romance
items.body: Two people, one obstacle and a box of tissues on standby.

items.title: Time-loop puzzle
items.body: The same day again and again until the rules make sense.

items.title: Animated musical
items.body: Songs, a sidekick and a lesson about being yourself.

items.title: Black-and-white noir
items.body: Rain, shadows and a detective who trusts nobody.

items.title: Experimental short
items.body: Twelve minutes of images that refuse to become a story.

items.title: Campfire folk song
items.body: Three chords, a story and everyone joining in on the chorus.

items.title: Ambient drone
items.body: Sound that changes so slowly it feels like weather.

items.title: Punk single
items.body: Two minutes, fast and loud, recorded in one take.

items.title: Symphony
items.body: A full orchestra working through themes over four movements.

items.title: Pop chart hit
items.body: A hook you know by the second chorus and can't forget by the third.

items.title: Free jazz
items.body: Improvisers listening hard and refusing the expected next note.

items.title: Lullaby
items.body: A few soft notes, repeated until someone falls asleep.

items.title: Blues standard
items.body: Twelve bars about trouble, sung so it hurts a little less.

items.title: Club techno
items.body: A steady kick drum for dancing until the lights come on.

items.title: Field recording
items.body: Birds, traffic and rain captured where they happened.

items.title: Assembly
items.body: Instructions for the processor itself, one register at a time.

items.title: Python
items.body: Readable, batteries included, and everywhere from scripts to science.

items.title: Haskell
items.body: Pure functions and a type system that proves things about your code.

items.title: C
items.body: Close to the metal and the foundation under most other languages.

items.title: Rust
items.body: Memory safety without a garbage collector, enforced by the compiler.

items.title: JavaScript
items.body: The language of the browser, now running nearly everywhere else.

items.title: Lisp
items.body: Code made of lists, so programs can write programs.

items.title: SQL
items.body: Describe the data you want and let the database work out how.

items.title: Scratch
items.body: Snap colorful blocks together to make games and animations.

items.title: Prolog
items.body: State facts and rules, then ask questions and let it search.
